components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single Market Pine action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: #fff; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 170 / 0.05); transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--primary-active); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Adjacent action when a primary exists.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface); border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Position state at a glance: dot + tint + label.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; flex: none; } .ds-pill-healthy { background: var(--primary-tint); color: oklch(0.38 0.07 170); } .ds-pill-healthy .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--primary); } .ds-pill-warn { background: var(--warn-fill); color: oklch(0.42 0.09 78); } .ds-pill-warn .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--warn); } .ds-pill-danger { background: var(--loss-fill); color: oklch(0.42 0.14 27); } .ds-pill-danger .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--loss); } .ds-pill-gain { background: var(--gain-fill); color: oklch(0.42 0.12 152); } .ds-pill-gain .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--gain); } .ds-pill-neutral { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--muted); } .ds-pill-neutral .ds-pill-dot { background: var(--faint); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-tint); }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: At-a-glance portfolio number with tabular value.
components.html: Total P/L₹ 48,250+8.4% overall return
components.css: .ds-kpi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 20px 24px; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 170 / 0.05); } .ds-kpi-label { font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--ink-strong); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi-gain { color: var(--gain); } .ds-kpi-loss { color: var(--loss); } .ds-kpi-sub { font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: 40px row; active state uses Market Pine Tint.
components.html: DashboardPortfolio
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item svg { color: var(--faint); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-item:hover svg { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--primary-tint); color: oklch(0.32 0.07 170); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active svg, .ds-nav-active:hover svg { color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: 32px Market Pine square with grid icon in white.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 170 / 0.05); }

narrative.overview:
Folio is a ledger the investor can trust at a glance. Every screen reads like a well-kept trading journal: calm, precise, and unhurried. The personality is sharp and analytical — nothing decorative, nothing urgent, nothing theatrical. The interface earns its density through real information: prices, quantities, P/L, stop-losses, and targets, all rendered in tabular numerals so a column of numbers can be compared by eye.

The palette is near-white paper tinted ever so slightly toward the primary's own green-teal hue, with a single deep Market Pine voice for actions and active states. Depth comes from tonal layering and hairline borders first; shadows appear only where a surface genuinely lifts (cards, the drawer, the brand mark). Color never carries meaning alone — gain and loss always pair with a label or direction arrow — because the investor may be color-blind, and the ledger must still be legible.

This system explicitly rejects the trading terminal (no dark screens, no glowing charts, no flickering tickers) and the generic SaaS cliché (no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no hero-metric landing, no identical icon-card grids). Folio's calm is a feature: the market is loud, the dashboard is not.
keyCharacteristics: One accent voice (Market Pine) for action and active state; semantic greens/reds/ambers only for P/L state.
Hairline borders and tonal surfaces over shadows; elevation is quiet and earned.
Tabular numerals everywhere numbers align in a column.
A single type family (Geist) carrying the whole hierarchy — contrast through weight, not font pairing.
Sticky, conventional structure (fixed sidebar, page headers, panel grid) so the data, not the chrome, gets the attention.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Market Pine is the only action color. One primary action per view; secondary and ghost exist so a screen never holds two pine buttons competing.

rules.name: The No-Gray-Gain Rule
rules.body: Gain and loss are never expressed as gray or as contrast alone. Always pair the semantic color with a label, a direction arrow, or a dot — color is an enhancement, not the message.

rules.name: The Tinted-Paper Rule
rules.body: Every near-white neutral is tinted toward hue 170 (the brand's own hue) with chroma 0.005–0.007. Warm beige, cream, and sand are prohibited as backgrounds.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every price, quantity, and percentage uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. A column of P/L must align like a printed statement.

rules.name: The Label-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Labels are always 11px, 600, uppercase, tracking 0.05–0.08em — never bold body text wearing a caps class, never 12–13px small caps hybrids.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is for labels only. Never uppercase a heading, a button label, or prose.

rules.name: The Quiet-Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation through tone first, shadow second. If a surface sits on the page background, it needs a hairline border or a tint, not a shadow. No element may use more than one shadow step.

dos: Do keep the Market Pine voice exclusive: one primary action per view, secondary/ghost everywhere else.
Do use tabular numerals for every price, quantity, P/L, and percentage.
Do prefer tonal layering and hairline borders for depth; reach for shadows only when a surface really lifts.
Do pair gain/loss color with a label, arrow, or dot — never color alone.
Do respect reduced motion: transitions collapse to near-instant, pulses stop.
Do keep placeholder text at ≥4.5:1 contrast; never the muted-gray default.
Do use the 11px uppercase label style consistently for field and KPI labels — it's the system's voice, not an eyebrow.
donts: Don't build a trading terminal: no dark backgrounds, no glowing or flickering charts, no blinking tickers, no urgency theatrics.
Don't reach for SaaS clichés: no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no hero-metric landing hero, no identical icon-card grids, no 01 / 02 / 03 scaffolding.
Don't use warm beige, cream, or sand backgrounds; every neutral tints toward hue 170.
Don't use a colored border-left or border-right accent stripe on cards, list items, or alerts — use full borders, tints, or dots.
Don't nest cards. A card is a leaf.
Don't use gray or pure #f00 for gain/loss; the semantic red is a muted oklch(0.47 0.17 27).
Don't uppercase headings, buttons, or prose — uppercase is the label style only.
Don't use arbitrary z-index values (999/9999); the token scale is dropdown → sticky → backdrop → modal → toast → tooltip.
